name: Lodesta awning mark

geometry.badgeBox: x 41-471, top y 66, valance attach y 380, scallop base y 446
geometry.notes: Valance depth, corner radius, and letter contrast are tuned so the silhouette and letter both survive a 16px favicon. Letter is optically centered between the solid-body center and the full-silhouette center, not centered in the body alone.

keyline.purpose: Brand green is 1.78:1 against the dark product canvas #151814, so without a keyline only the letter reads and the awning silhouette disappears. The keyline restores the silhouette on dark and is invisible on light, because warm white on a near-white surface has no edge.
keyline.technique: stroke on the badge path with paint-order="stroke", so the fill covers the inner half and the visible keyline is entirely outward. stroke-width is twice the visible width.
keyline.rule: Size the keyline to land just under 1px at the size that asset actually renders — target roughly 0.75px. A full pixel reads as a sticker outline. This is why the two exports differ.
keyline.lodesta-mark.svg: 12 units visible (stroke-width 24). Renders at 30/32/34px in the owner, admin, and auth shells, giving 0.70-0.80px.
keyline.lodesta-mark-favicon.svg: 24 units visible (stroke-width 48). Renders at 16px as the favicon, giving 0.75px.
keyline.letterScale: The favicon variant also carries the letter at 1.10x, scaled about its optical centre (256, 228) and flattened into the path coordinates rather than left as a transform. Cap height 220 vs 200, width 171.6 vs 156, still centred at x=256, clearances top 52 / bottom-to-valance 34 / sides 129.2. This is the third size-specific deviation in the favicon export, alongside the lighter keyline and the low-contrast letterform — all three exist because 16px is the binding constraint and nothing else renders that small.
keyline.cutout: lodesta-mark-cutout.* intentionally has no keyline. It is a knockout treatment for placing on brand green, where an outward warm-white edge would fight the intent.

exports.purpose: Source for app/icon.png. Identical geometry to lodesta-mark.svg with a heavier 32-unit keyline for 16px rendering.
Next.js application favicon, rasterized from lodesta-mark-favicon.svg (not lodesta-mark.svg)

provenance: Vector geometry was rebuilt deterministically from the selected visual direction. PNG files are rasterized directly from the corresponding SVG files via sharp at 1024x1024. No font dependency or embedded raster image is used.
maskedContexts: This mark's scalloped lower edge is clipped by circular and squircle avatar masks (iOS/Android app icons, Slack, Google, GitHub org avatars). No circle-masked variant is currently checked in; generate one before shipping to any of those surfaces.
